name: Shimmer Stout
summary: At Brewnall Village, Rejold Barleybrew sends a fresh barrel of Shimmer Stout to his brother Wellart. Wellart guards the pass toward Loch Modan, where a cold post makes a strong drink welcome.

sections.title: A Family Recipe on the Frontier
sections.body: Rejold Barleybrew has perfected Shimmer Stout with shimmering fronds gathered from Dun Morogh’s icy crags. His family tends the vats and kegs of Brewnall Village, but his brother Wellart chose life as a Mountaineer. Rejold knows how lonely frontier guard duty can be, so he sends a fresh barrel with passing travelers. It is a favor between brothers and a chance to test the brew.

sections.title: The South Gate Guard Tower
sections.body: Wellart Barleybrew guards the South Gate Pass into Loch Modan from the southern tower. High in the pass, Mountaineers face bitter winds and occasional beast attacks while watching over travelers on the mountain road. Wellart is running low on drink and restless for excitement. Shimmer Stout packs quite a punch, he finds, and seems to brighten his vision in the dim mountain night.

faq.answer: Mountaineer Wellart Barleybrew is Rejold Barleybrew’s brother. While his kin brew ale in Brewnall Village, Wellart serves with the Dun Morogh Mountaineers, watching the high pass between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan.

faq.q: Where is the southern guard tower located?
faq.answer: The southern tower sits along Dun Morogh’s eastern border, guarding the South Gate Pass through the mountains toward Loch Modan.
Shimmer Stout is brewed with special shimmering fronds gathered in the snowy wilderness. Wellart says it brightens his eyes and makes him feel as though he can see through the dark.

faq.q: What happens after Wellart drinks the stout?
aliases: what is next after shimmer stout
faq.answer: Wellart enjoys the brew and asks travelers to carry another keg into Loch Modan for Mountaineer Kadrell, who patrols the road through Thelsamar.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know sharing ale with family matters as much as guarding the mountain passes. This delivery is part of frontier life in Ironforge.
As an Alliance traveler, you help keep the Mountaineers supplied as they guard the highway between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan.
